Met Éireann 5 Day Rain Forecast:
Approximately 63mm of rain is forecast for the Shannon catchment to Lough Allen over the
next 5 days.

Derg over the next 5 days.
Level at Athlone Downstream:
Gauge is downstream of Athlone Weir and is a measure of the water level at the north end of
the callows south of Athlone.
Note: All sluices at Athlone Weir closed as of 06/10/2020
Discharge at Parteen Weir:
It is expected that there will be no additional discharge necessary at Parteen Weir over
the next 5 days based on current weather forecast.

Note: Lough Derg level is taken to be average of level recorded at Portumna and Pier Head, Killaloe.

direction.
